metadata.name: maplibre
metadata.description: Renders a MapLibre GL JS map styled with free, keyless OpenFreeMap tiles, and displays a bindable array of points as pin/image/text-pill/icon markers with clickable popups.
features: OpenFreeMap styles (liberty, bright, positron, dark) or a custom MapLibre style URL, no API key required
Bindable points array with per-field Formula mapping (latitude, longitude, label, description, color, image, icons)
Five marker types: pin, image, text pill, icon, icon and text pill
Hover and selected states with configurable growth scale per marker type
Dropzone popup anchored to the clicked point, built from WeWeb elements, bound to selectedPoint
Optional navigation, geolocate, scroll-zoom and attribution controls
Component actions to fly to coordinates, reset north, and select/hover points programmatically

properties.name: mapStyle
properties.description: OpenFreeMap base style, overridden by customStyleUrl if set.

properties.name: customStyleUrl
properties.description: URL to a MapLibre style JSON, overrides mapStyle when set.

properties.name: initialLatitude
properties.description: Initial map center latitude.

properties.name: initialLongitude
properties.description: Initial map center longitude.

properties.name: initialZoom
properties.description: Initial zoom level (0-22).

properties.name: scrollZoom
properties.description: Enable zooming the map with the mouse wheel/trackpad.

properties.name: showNavigation
properties.description: Show the zoom in/out and compass control.

properties.name: showGeolocate
properties.description: Show the geolocate (center on user) control.

properties.name: showAttribution
properties.description: Show OpenFreeMap/MapLibre attribution (recommended to keep on).

properties.name: moveDebounce
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait after the map stops moving before firing 'On map move'.

properties.name: points
properties.description: Array of point objects to render as markers (id, latitude, longitude, label, description, color, image, icon, iconTrailing, displayIcon, displayIconTrailing, iconColor, iconColorSelected).

properties.name: pointsIdFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its id field.

properties.name: pointsLatitudeFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its latitude field.

properties.name: pointsLongitudeFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its longitude field.

properties.name: pointsLabelFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its label field.

properties.name: pointsDescriptionFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its description field.

properties.name: pointsColorFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its marker color field.

properties.name: pointsImageFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its image URL field.

properties.name: pointsIconFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its leading icon field.

properties.name: pointsIconTrailingFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its trailing icon field.

properties.name: pointsDisplayIconFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row to whether the leading icon is shown.

properties.name: pointsDisplayIconTrailingFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row to whether the trailing icon is shown.

properties.name: pointsIconColorFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row of a bound points collection to its icon color field.

properties.name: pointsIconColorSelectedFormula
properties.description: Formula mapping each row to its selected-state icon color field.

properties.name: markerType
properties.description: Marker visual style: pin | image | text-pill | icon | icon-text-pill.

properties.name: defaultMarkerColor
properties.description: Fallback color for pin and icon markers when a point has no own color.

properties.name: defaultMarkerImage
properties.description: Fallback image for image markers when a point has no own image.

properties.name: markerWidth
properties.description: Image marker width in pixels.

properties.name: markerHeight
properties.description: Image marker height in pixels.

properties.name: imageScale
properties.description: Scale factor applied to an image marker on hover/selected (1 = no scaling).

properties.name: imageScaleOrigin
properties.description: Point the image marker grows from when scaling: anchor | center | top | bottom | left | right.

properties.name: markerImageAnchor
properties.description: Which part of a non-pin marker sits on the coordinate: bottom | center | top.

properties.name: markerIcon
properties.description: Leading system icon for icon / icon-text-pill marker types.

properties.name: markerIconTrailing
properties.description: Trailing system icon for the icon-text-pill marker type.

properties.name: markerIconSize
properties.description: Icon size in pixels.

properties.name: markerIconColor
properties.description: Icon color.

properties.name: markerIconColorHover
properties.description: Icon color on hover, falls back to the base color when empty.

properties.name: markerIconColorSelected
properties.description: Icon color when the point is selected, falls back to the base color when empty.

properties.name: iconScale
properties.description: Scale factor applied to an icon marker's circle on hover/selected (1 = no scaling).

properties.name: iconScaleOrigin
properties.description: Point the icon circle grows from when scaling: anchor | center | top | bottom | left | right.

properties.name: markerIconGap
properties.description: Gap in pixels between icon and label text in icon-text-pill markers.

properties.name: pillTextColor
properties.description: Text pill label color.

properties.name: pillTextColorHover
properties.description: Text pill label color on hover, falls back to the base color when empty.

properties.name: pillTextColorSelected
properties.description: Text pill label color when selected, falls back to the base color when empty.

properties.name: pillTextSize
properties.description: Text pill font size in pixels.

properties.name: pillTextWeight
properties.description: Text pill font weight (400/500/600/700).

properties.name: pillBgColor
properties.description: Text pill background color; a point's own color overrides this.

properties.name: pillBgColorHover
properties.description: Text pill background color on hover, falls back to the base background when empty.

properties.name: pillBgColorSelected
properties.description: Text pill background color when selected, falls back to the base background when empty.

properties.name: pillScale
properties.description: Scale factor applied to a pill on hover/selected (1 = no scaling).

properties.name: pillScaleOrigin
properties.description: Point the pill grows from when scaling: anchor | center | top | bottom | left | right.

properties.name: pillPadding
properties.description: Text pill CSS padding.

properties.name: pillRadius
properties.description: Text pill CSS border-radius.

properties.name: pillShadow
properties.description: Text pill CSS box-shadow.

properties.name: showPopups
properties.description: Open the popup dropzone anchored to a point when its marker is clicked.

properties.name: autoFlipPopup
properties.description: Open the popup below the point instead of above when there isn't room above.

properties.name: popupContent
properties.description: Hidden dropzone property holding the WeWeb elements rendered inside the map popup.

properties.name: popupGap
properties.description: Vertical gap in pixels between the marker tip and the popup.

properties.name: forcePopupInEditor
properties.description: Editor only: keep the popup open on the first point to design it. No effect in production.

events.name: map:load
events.description: Fires once the map has finished loading.

events.name: map:click
events.description: Fires when the map background is clicked.

events.name: map:move
events.description: Fires after the map stops moving (debounced by moveDebounce).

events.name: marker:click
events.description: Fires when a marker is clicked, before the popup opens.

events.name: marker:mouseenter
events.description: Fires when the pointer enters a marker.

events.name: marker:mouseleave
events.description: Fires when the pointer leaves a marker.

events.name: popup:open
events.description: Fires when the popup opens for a point.

actions.label: Fly to
actions.description: Animate (or jump) the map to the given latitude/longitude/zoom.

args.name: zoom
args.description: Optional target zoom level; current zoom is kept if omitted/invalid.

args.name: animate
args.description: Animate the transition (true) or jump instantly (false).

actions.label: Reset north
actions.description: Swing the map back to north-up, optionally also resetting tilt.

actions.label: Select point
actions.description: Select the point matching the given id, highlighting its marker and opening its popup as a click would.

args.name: id
args.description: Point id to select (matches the mapped ID field or array index).

actions.label: Hover point
actions.description: Programmatically apply the hover state to the point matching the given id.

actions.label: Unhover point
actions.description: Clear the hover state from the given point, or whichever point is currently hovered if omitted.

actions.label: Close popup
actions.description: Close the currently open popup, if any.

slots.name: popupContent
slots.description: Dropzone rendered inside the map popup. Bind its content to the selectedPoint component variable to display the clicked point's data.

variables.name: isMapLoaded
variables.description: Whether the map has finished its initial load.

variables.name: selectedPoint
variables.description: The raw resolved data of the currently selected (popup-open) point, or null.

specifications: The element must have an explicit height (or a parent with one) — the map fills its container fluidly and collapses to 0 height otherwise.
Keep 'Show attribution' on to comply with OpenFreeMap / MapLibre terms unless attribution is provided elsewhere.
When 'Points' is bound to external data, map each field with the per-field Formula properties (pointsLatitudeFormula, pointsLongitudeFormula, etc.).

Design the popup by dropping WeWeb elements into the popupContent dropzone and binding their content to the selectedPoint component variable; in the editor the popup auto-opens on the first point (toggle via 'Force popup open (editor)'), in production it opens on marker click.

To use a custom marker image, set 'Default marker image' (applies to all points) or a point's own 'Image URL' (overrides the default for that point), and map it via pointsImageFormula when bound to external data.
No API key is required; map styles are served by the free OpenFreeMap tile service.
